data.body_html:
New Year's Eve 2048 in Marbella is set to be spectacular – and the best seat in the house is on the water. A Marbella boat rental NYE 2048 fireworks view from Puerto Banús lets you watch the midnight sky explode over the Mediterranean, with cava in hand and the glittering coast as your backdrop. No crowds, no pushing for a spot on the promenade – just you, your guests, and the show.

Why Watch the Fireworks from a Boat?

The NYE fireworks in Marbella are launched from the coast near Puerto Banús, and the bay becomes a natural amphitheatre. From a boat, you get a clear, unobstructed view of the entire display – something you'll never get from the packed shoreline. Plus, you can celebrate in comfort: heated decks (if you choose a flybridge), your favourite music, and unlimited cava.

With our fleet departing directly from Puerto Banús, you're minutes from the action. And after the fireworks, you can cruise slowly back to the marina, avoiding the traffic jams that clog the Golden Mile until 2am.

Our Boats for NYE 2048

We have a range of vessels to suit every group size and budget. Here's a quick overview:

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras.

Top Boats for a Fireworks Party

For a Marbella boat rental NYE 2048 fireworks view, we recommend these:

  • Mangusta 80 – 24m of pure style, with a huge flybridge and a free jet ski for daytime fun. Perfect for a group of up to 12.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge – a classic flybridge with a panoramic saloon and generous deck space. Ideal for mingling.
  • Astondoa 40 – compact but mighty, great for couples or small groups who want an intimate celebration.

If you're on a tighter budget, the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) or Red Tide (11m, 6 pax) are available on request – but book early, they go fast.

What's Included in Every Charter

We keep it simple: the price you see is the price you pay. Every boat includes:

  • Licensed, experienced skipper
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You're welcome to bring your own food and extra drinks – just let us know, and we'll have a cooler ready. For a premium touch, we can arrange a catered platter from a local chef (ask for a quote).

How to Book Your NYE 2048 Charter

Booking is easy. Head to our [main boat rental page](/), choose your preferred boat, and send us a WhatsApp message with your date (31 December 2048) and desired duration. We'll confirm availability and send you a secure payment link. A 30% deposit secures the booking, with the balance due 2 weeks before departure.

Because NYE is our busiest night, we recommend booking at least 3-4 months in advance. Last-minute availability is rare, and prices may increase closer to the date.

NYE 2048 Itinerary Suggestion

To make the most of your evening, here's a sample timeline:

  • 21:30 – Board your boat at Puerto Banús. Welcome cava and snacks.
  • 22:00 – Cruise along the coast towards Cabopino, enjoying the sunset and the lights of Marbella.
  • 23:00 – Anchor in the bay near Puerto Banús, the best spot for the fireworks.
  • 23:59 – Countdown with cava in hand.
  • 00:15 – Fireworks finale – watch from the deck or the bow.
  • 00:30 – Cruise back to the marina, toasting the new year.

If you book an 8-hour charter, you can extend the party with a late-night cruise to Estepona or even Sotogrande – just ask your skipper.
